description: CFD AMR with the placement of the patches (G 40 1) on 2 ranks: the refined box (on rank 0's level 0) cut vertically into two units filling the ranks to the mean work, the unit on rank 1 reads its coarser level from its shadow (a copy of the level-0 cells under it and around it), the restriction, the coarse faces and the fluxes of the patch edges go back to rank 0.
covers: reefamr3d::place_units (fill the ranks, conforming vertical cut)
the shadows: down (fills, predictor, KC), up (restriction, coarse faces, pr_apply, folds, multigrid couplings)
